name: Maiti2026Power.NormEstParam.pastOf
doc: The past actions of a history of the first `n` rounds, extended by the zero action.

statement.value: if hr : a✝ < n then (h ⟨a✝, hr⟩).action else unitBallZero

name: Maiti2026Power.NormEstParam.alg
doc: The norm-estimation meta-algorithm as a seeded algorithm on the unit ball.

statement.value:
{ seed := ProbabilityTheory.uniformBoolVec ι, isProbabilityMeasure_seed := ⋯,
  next := fun n h u => P.nextAction n (pastOf h) (P.jStar ι (yOf h)) u, measurable_next := ⋯ }

code:
/-- The norm-estimation meta-algorithm as a seeded algorithm on the unit ball. -/
noncomputable def alg (ι : Type*) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] :
    SeededAlg (unitBall ι) ℝ (ι → Bool) where
  seed := uniformBoolVec ι
  next n h u := P.nextAction (ι := ι) n (pastOf h) (P.jStar ι (yOf h)) u
  measurable_next n := by
    have h1 : Measurable fun p : ℕ × (Hist Unit (unitBall ι) ℝ n × (ι → Bool)) ↦
        P.nextAction (ι := ι) n (pastOf p.2.1) p.1 p.2.2 :=
      measurable_from_prod_countable_right fun js ↦ P.measurable_nextAction n js
    have h2 : Measurable fun p : Hist Unit (unitBall ι) ℝ n × (ι → Bool) ↦
        (P.jStar ι (yOf p.1), p) :=
      ((P.measurable_jStar).comp ((measurable_yOf n).comp measurable_fst)).prodMk measurable_id
    exact h1.comp h2

code:
/-- The action of the plan at round `t`, given the outcome `js` of the multi-scale phase and the
seed sequence `u`. -/
noncomputable def planAction (js t : ℕ) (u : ℕ → ι → Bool) : unitBall ι :=
  match P.rbBlock (ι := ι) js t with
  | some b => ⟨radDir (u b), radDir_mem_unitBall _⟩
  | none =>
    match P.basisRound (ι := ι) js t with
    | some i => ⟨EuclideanSpace.single i 1, single_mem_unitBall i⟩
    | none => unitBallZero

name: Maiti2026Power.NormEstParam.nextAction
doc:
The action at round `t` computed from the past actions `past`, the outcome `js` and the
fresh seed `u`.

statement.value:
match P.rbBlock js t with
| some b => if b = t then ⟨radDir u, ⋯⟩ else past b
| none =>
  match P.basisRound js t with
  | some i => ⟨EuclideanSpace.single i 1, ⋯⟩
  | none => unitBallZero

code:
/-- The action at round `t` computed from the past actions `past`, the outcome `js` and the
fresh seed `u`. -/
noncomputable def nextAction (t : ℕ) (past : ℕ → unitBall ι) (js : ℕ) (u : ι → Bool) :
    unitBall ι :=
  match P.rbBlock (ι := ι) js t with
  | some b => if b = t then ⟨radDir u, radDir_mem_unitBall _⟩ else past b
  | none =>
    match P.basisRound (ι := ι) js t with
    | some i => ⟨EuclideanSpace.single i 1, single_mem_unitBall i⟩
    | none => unitBallZero

name: Maiti2026Power.NormEstParam.measurable_nextAction

statement.conclusion: Measurable fun p => P.nextAction t (pastOf p.1) js p.2

code:
lemma measurable_nextAction (t js : ℕ) {n : ℕ} :
    Measurable fun p : Hist Unit (unitBall ι) ℝ n × (ι → Bool) ↦
      P.nextAction (ι := ι) t (pastOf p.1) js p.2
proof:
:=
  P.measurable_nextAction_of t js fun b ↦ measurable_pastOf_apply b

name: Maiti2026Power.single_mem_unitBall
code: lemma single_mem_unitBall (i : ι) : EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ) ∈ unitBall ι

name: Maiti2026Power.NormEstParam.measurable_pastOf_apply

statement.conclusion: Measurable fun h => pastOf h r

code:
lemma measurable_pastOf_apply {n : ℕ} (r : ℕ) :
    Measurable fun h : Hist Unit (unitBall ι) ℝ n ↦ pastOf h r
proof:
:= by
  unfold pastOf
  split_ifs
  exacts [Round.measurable_action.comp (measurable_pi_apply _), measurable_const]

name: Maiti2026Power.NormEstParam.measurable_nextAction_of

binders.name: hpast
binders.type: ∀ (b : ℕ), Measurable fun a => past a b

statement.conclusion: Measurable fun p => P.nextAction t (past p.1) js p.2

code:
lemma measurable_nextAction_of (t js : ℕ) {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α]
    {past : α → ℕ → unitBall ι} (hpast : ∀ b, Measurable fun a ↦ past a b) :
    Measurable fun p : α × (ι → Bool) ↦ P.nextAction (ι := ι) t (past p.1) js p.2
proof:
:= by
  unfold nextAction
  rcases hb : P.rbBlock (ι := ι) js t with _ | b
  · rcases hi : P.basisRound (ι := ι) js t with _ | i
    · exact measurable_const
    · exact measurable_const
  · simp only
    split_ifs
    · exact (measurable_radDir.comp measurable_snd).subtype_mk
    · exact (hpast b).comp measurable_fst

name: Maiti2026Power.unitBallZero
doc: The zero action of the unit ball.
code:
/-- The zero action of the unit ball. -/
def unitBallZero : unitBall ι := ⟨0, zero_mem_unitBall⟩

name: Maiti2026Power.NormEstParam.output
doc:
The deterministic output of the meta-algorithm: the estimate computed from the observations
of the history of the `T` rounds.
code:
/-- The deterministic output of the meta-algorithm: the estimate computed from the observations
of the history of the `T` rounds. -/
noncomputable def output (ι : Type*) [Fintype ι] (h : Hist Unit (unitBall ι) ℝ (P.T ι)) : ℝ :=
  P.estimate ι (yOf h)
